scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted palette (warm tan, orange, teal) and clean card layout show design thought, but the visualization is clipped at the bottom and the edge bundles converge into a dense, illegible tangle at the center of the circle pack.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt for force-node sizing, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions on all joins, no zero-baseline violations (no bar/area charts), and the sunburst radial scaleSqrt correctly equalizes ring area rather than deceiving.
scores.stress_test_note: Multiple un-throttled update storms from the tension and easing-param sliders, a broken transition guard, a force-simulation/morph transition conflict, and absent touch filtering combine to create significant interaction fragility under rapid user input.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Color-grouped clusters (up to 10 Tableau hues, 3-4 visible) read clearly and group membership is immediately legible, but 300 bundled edges among ~200 nodes converge into a dense trunk tangle at the center that obscures individual connection paths; animation congruence across 8 layout modes cannot be assessed from a static screenshot but reheating a force simulation on every layout switch would be a significant risk.
flags: Update Storm: tension slider fires redrawLinks() on every input event without debounce/RAF; broken transition guard (.transitioning class never applied) makes it a no-op
Update Storm: easing-params sliders call updateLayout() (full 1500ms transition) on every mousemove input event with no throttling

Mid-Flight Race Condition: force layout calls runForceSimulation() immediately while a concurrent 750ms flubber attrTween is mid-flight on individual path elements, causing conflicting position updates
Mid-Flight Race Condition: no explicit .interrupt() call before new svg.transition() in updateLayout(); rapid layout switching or easing slider dragging queues overlapping transitions
Mouse-Touch Fight: no event.preventDefault() or touch/mouse filter on node click/mouseover/mouseout handlers; drag() in force mode has no event.sourceEvent filter for touch vs pointer disambiguation

proposer: 1012 → 994 lines. Removed the custom `shuffle` function (replaced with `d3.shuffle`), consolidated 8 button handlers into a 2-line loop, and merged 3 identical switch cases.
